text:
kevin: Quick follow-up from today's infra all-hands. Two asks from GTM: a concise customer line about APAC availability windows and a short troubleshooting note for CS on degraded perf. Can infra give copy + one procedural note?

sophia: Sure. Short customer line: "Targeting an invite-only APAC pilot in late September; broader availability expected in early Q4 pending hardware shipments." Procedural note for CS: if customers see increased latency, check region health + fallback status, then escalate to infra if cross-region failover triggered.

mina: Can infra confirm which hardware families APAC pilot will include (H100 vs A100)? Procurement needs that to prioritize orders.

sophia: Pilot will start on a mix: primarily A100 for initial capacity, we hope to add H100 for high-throughput customers in the GA wave. H100 availability is the gating factor for some Dedicated SKUs.

oliver: For ops: what's the concrete runbook step when APAC region falls below 35% available? We need exact actions to automate.

sophia: Proposed automated actions: <35% -> mark region as "constrained", spin up cross-region warm pool (same continent) for priority routes, set non-priority routes to quantized fallback; <15% -> enable emergency throttling and notify on-call. We'll PR these thresholds.

lisa: Procurement note: vendor X pushed one H100 crate by ~3 weeks. That reduces our APAC H100 buffer ~15%. Posting details in #procurement-watch.

capacity-bot: Snapshot (ts 2143001300):
```
US-West: 93%
US-East: 88%
EMEA: 69%
APAC: 37%
```

kevin: CS also asked: what should be in the email to customers who are invited to the pilot? Anything special about expected perf?

sophia: Recommend calling out: "pilot customers may see occasional cross-region routing which can increase p95 latency by ~50-200ms. We will share traffic routing logs and a dedicated support channel for pilots." Keep it explicit about variability.

mina: Will we provide a toggle so pilot customers can opt out of cross-region routing? Some customers asked for region-only operation.

sophia: Yes, for pilot we'll honor a strict region-only mode per account, but we'll warn about potential request failures when local capacity is exhausted. That's already supported in Dedicated via region-pinning. We'll add a pilot flag for Hosted pilot accounts.

oliver: Ops automation request: can infra emit a metric `infra_region_mode` with values: normal/constrained/emergency so CS and on-call can filter?

sophia: Good idea. We'll add `infra_region_mode{region="$REGION"}` and a short dashboard with alert thresholds.

lisa: Action items recap: - sophia: one-paragraph pilot blurb + CS troubleshooting snippet (due EOD today) - sophia: PR runbook thresholds and `infra_region_mode` metric (due Mon) - mina: consolidate hardware priority list and share with procurement (due Thu) - lisa: post procurement H100 delay details to #procurement-watch (done).

capacity-bot: New procurement alert: Vendor X H100 crate ETA shifted to 2143200000; APAC H100 buffer -15%.

kevin: Thanks. Last tiny ask: please @exec-comm on the final blurb so we can schedule the customer email.

sophia: Will do once blurb is posted.

lisa: I'll also create a short CS paste-ready template and link it here when ready.

kevin: Perfect, thanks all.
